description: Flat 5x5 grid: right-closed interval means Q=0.0001 m3/s on (0,1], Q=0.0003 on (1,2]. Exact storage at 1 and 2 seconds is 0.0001 and 0.0004 m3.
source: Floodcast-authored analytic synthetic fixture; no external geographic or scientific data.
license: Project-authored data for authorized Floodcast development; no third-party data. Repository redistribution license is not yet assigned.
expectations: Model exit0 and normal completion in stdout and persisted model log.
Exact snapshot times/columns, finite nonnegative depths, unique integer cell IDs inside DEM bounds, and coordinates consistent with grid spacing and origin; wet-propagation excludes boundary wetting.
Stored volume equals independently derived Q*t or rain-depth times area within declared tolerances; expected cell coverage/spreading verified.
tolerance_rationale: Allow float32 forcing representation and text output rounding. These are numerical regression tolerances, not physical accuracy estimates.
